BETWEEN:-
 KAMAL KUMAR S/O KANHAIYALAL VAISHNAV, AGED  ABOUT 29 YEARS, OCCUPATION:

SERVICE GRAM  KALYAKHEDI DISTRICT RAJGARH (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (SHRI AKHILESH KUMAR SAXENA, LEARNED COUNSEL FOR THE  APPLICANT .)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION BIAORA DISTRICT RAJGARH (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 ( SHRI AJAY GUPTA, LEARNED GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE FOR THE  RESPONDENT/STATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER
The present petition has been filed against the order dated 30.07.2022 whereby the learned trial Court has rejected the application filed for release of the motorcycle on Supurdigi.
The applicant is the owner of motorcycle bearing registration no.MP-39- MQ-7880 which has been seized by the police in Crime No.557/2021 for offence under Sections 420,409,467,471 of IPC.

As per prosecution story, the brother of the applicant Rahul has cheated the complainant and has taken some money and out of that money he purchased the motorcycle for his brother, therefore, the police has seized the motorcycle.

The applicant being a registered owner of the motorcycle has filed an application for release of the motorcycle, but the trial Court has dismissed the application as this Kamal Kumar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138772967/

sentences.text: 1 article was seized in the criminal case.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the motorcycle is lying in the campus of the police station without any protection.
He purchased the motorcycle from his own money for a sum of Rs.50,000/- and is not able to use the same and he will suffer irreparable loss.
He has nothing to do with the crime registered against his brother.
Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer and prays for dismissal of this petition.
On due consideration of the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of record, this petition deserves to be allowed.
The impugned order dated 30.07.2022 is set aside.

The trial Court is directed to pass an appropriate order by imposing conditions, which may be deemed fit, for 'Supurdginama' within one week from the date of production of certified copy of the order passed today.
(VIVEK RUSIA) JUDGE RJ Kamal Kumar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138772967/
